registration: PLM Owner original service + exact Scope/BizType/PLM_ITER_REVIEW; UNPROVEN until real consumer registered

fields.scope: trusted original environment/tenant, same as Binding/Aggregate
fields.commandId: UUID persisted once for Owner submission command; original retry unchanged
fields.subject.businessOwner,bizType: exact deployed original Owner registration, never browser values
fields.subject.contentDigest: sha256 of exact new snapshot canonical UTF8 bytes; canonicalizationVersion ITER-OA-SNAPSHOT/1; never overwrite native package digest
fields.policy.ref: original native policy Ref if OA Ref domain-valid; otherwise immutable alias Ref registered by PLM resolving complete native bytes
fields.policy.version,digest: Binding.policyVersion/policyDigest; unregistered/non-sha256 algorithm is FENCED, never coerced
fields.replacesSubmissionId: original explicitly superseded prior submission or null
fields.starterId,submitAuthorizationRef,separat: trusted Owner actor/current submit authorization/full native author and SOD set
fields.snapshot.canonicalBytesBase64: canonical UTF8 of closed {schema,aggregate,binding}, complete objects
fields.snapshot.digest: same exact byte digest as subject.contentDigest
fields.snapshot.immutableEvidenceRefs: full OA-domain references to original package/policy and native evidence, using registered aliases only when required
fields.engineering.digest,engineering.reviewPac: Binding.reviewPackageDigest from original immutable package, not aggregateDigest
fields.engineering.reviewPackageRef: exact original package Ref or registered immutable alias preserving full native reference
fields.engineering.purpose: registered original review purpose, not arbitrary browser input
fields.reason: current explicit user reason within OA <=500 Unicode characters
fields.ownerOutboxId: immutable UUID saved in same Owner transaction
fields.ownerFrozenAt: actual Owner freeze transaction UTC with milliseconds
fields.DecisionEnvelope: full original OA envelope retained; require exact Scope/submission/subject/policy/round/engineering snapshot binding before applying
fields.ApplicationReceipt: original OA shape; action PLM_ITER_REVIEW_DECISION; subject from original submission; actual result/revision/audit/actor and previousReceiptId from Owner transaction; never copied from decision as proof of application

alias_rule: Persist Scope + reference kind + complete native reference bytes/schema pin/digest + OA UUID key/version. Original domain-valid Round key is kept; otherwise unique persistent UUID alias is stored as oaRoundKey. Alias lookup is current-authorized immutable resolution, cannot claim original Owner emitted the alias. Missing or conflicting alias blocks submit. No substring/hash-as-ID fallback.
limits: OA 1MiB body,256KiB snapshot,1000 ID entries; full candidate/evidence set required. Oversize blocks this route pending separately registered transport; no truncation.
